notes: 2026-04-10 blog post. First end-to-end application solved using logical qubits on neutral-atom hardware: differential equations via quantum kernels. 2 logical qubits used; logical qubits outperformed physical qubits due to natural noise suppression for this problem class. arXiv paper announced as 'coming soon' — not yet posted at scan date. Physical qubit count not disclosed. Error correction code not specified. This is a CATCH-UP milestone (just before our April 26 window start). RELEVANCE TO OUR WORK: Low logical qubit count (2) — not directly applicable to MERA circuits. Significant as the first neutral-atom end-to-end logical application. Pasqal Vela (256+ physical qubits, H1 2026 target) still not launched as of scan close date (2026-05-12).
